author: zeldaslop67
quote:
Listen… I’m not even gonna lie. I’ve been riding Zelda’s meat for years. That kids’ slop is my comfort game. 167 hours deep and I still go back to it.

Then I touched GTA 6.

I don’t even know how to explain it. The immersion is disgusting. The world, the physics, the NPCs, the freedom… it actually made me sit there like a clown questioning every hour I wasted on Nintendo. This isn’t just “better than Zelda.” This is a different sport.

And yeah, I already see it coming. All the Zelda and Nintendo **** riders are gonna review-bomb this masterpiece because their favorite little cartoon game just got cooked in every category.

I said what I said.

GTA 6 is the greatest game ever made. Period.

- zeldaslop67
